description:
**Rescoped 2026-05-11 after code-state audit.**

Original framing (decide the VerifyReport shape from scratch) is moot: `verify_chain()` already returns `Result<ValidatedPath, Error>`. `ValidatedPath` carries `anchor_index`, `depth`, and §6.1.5 wrap-up outputs (leaf subject DN, issuer DN, serial, SPKI). The error type is a flat enum with one variant per RFC 5280 failure mode.

What remains: **should new verify_* wrappers return a richer structured-findings type on top of the existing Result, or just propagate the underlying Result?**

**Options:**

- **A) Pass-through.** `verify_tls_server(...) -> Result<ValidatedPath, Error>`. Same shape as `verify_chain`. New error variants for `HostnameMismatch`, `MalformedSan`, etc. Simple, matches existing convention.
- **B) Structured report.** `verify_tls_server(...) -> VerifyReport { outcome, findings, validated_path }` where `findings: Vec<Finding>` lists every check that ran (Pass / Warn / Error / Notice), even on success. Useful for compliance reporting / audit / lint integration.
- **C) Hybrid.** Default return is `Result<ValidatedPath, Error>`. Optional verbose variant (`verify_tls_server_verbose(...) -> VerifyReport`) for callers who want structured findings.

**A is the lowest-friction shape.** B earns its keep only if `.6` chooses to fold lint findings into the same pipeline AND callers want lint findings rolled up with verify outcomes. C is the easy compromise but doubles the API surface.

**Lower priority than the identity-binding gap.** Can ship after the main verify_* wrappers land.

Decision-gate. Human label inherited from parent.
title: Decide structured-findings layer on top of Result<ValidatedPath, Error>
